'''Secon Daree''' was a [[Lutrillian]] who [[Rebel pilot|piloted]] an [[X-wing starfighter]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] during the ill-fated [[attack on Lothal]]. Daree was captured by the [[Noghri]] [[assassin]] [[Rukh]], who handed the pilot to Imperial custody.

==Biography==
Secon Daree<ref name="Rebel Assault Trivia Gallery" /> was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot|starfighter]] [[pilot]]. In [[1 BBY]], Daree took part in [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]]'s [[Attack on Lothal|attack]] on [[Lothal]] to destroy the [[Imperial Armory Complex|Imperial factories]] there. Syndulla's [[starfighter]] force was intercepted by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] and suffered heavy [[Death|casualties]]. After Syndulla managed to create a perimeter in the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] defenses by causing [[Commander]] [[Vult Skerris]]' [[TIE/D Defender Elite]] to crash into two Imperial [[warship]]s, Daree and the remaining fighters including Syndulla and [[Mart Mattin]]'s [[X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] breached Lothal's [[atmosphere]]. The [[pilot]] cheered once Syndulla created an opening.<ref name="Rebel Assault" />

When the remaining Rebel starfighters were shot down by the second wave of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]], Daree was one of the few survivors, crash-landing in [[Capital City|Lothal City]]. Daree was captured by [[Rukh]], Grand Admiral Thrawn's personal [[assassin]], who had been sent out to capture the remaining Rebel pilots. Upon being brought to [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]], she ordered that Daree be taken away for interrogation.<ref name="Rebel Assault" />

==Personality and traits==
Second Daree was a [[Lutrillian]] with a [[Color|pinkish]] broad face, fuzzy jowls, and wide-set blue [[eye]]s. Daree was a member of the Rebel Alliance and flew a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="Rebel Assault" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StarWarsRebels_409_RebelAssault_ConceptArt_LutrillianPilot.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Secon Daree in concept art by Luke Harrington]]
Secon Daree appears in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Rebel Assault]]."<ref name="Rebel Assault" /> The pilot was named in the accompanying guide, where it notes that the production team gave the pilot the name in the script as a joke,<ref name="Rebel Assault Trivia Gallery" /> a play on the word "secondary."

Although unnamed in the artwork by Luke Harrington, concept art for Secon Daree's character model appears in the episode's concept art gallery, as ''X-wing starfighter pilot concept art''.<ref name="Rebel Assault BTS Gallery">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/rebel-assault-behind-the-scenes-gallery|text="Rebel Assault" Behind-the-Scenes Gallery}} {{C|Slide 9}}</ref>
